fetched.title: Aircall Help Center | Aircall plans: pricing and flexibility
fetched.text:
Aircall offers several subscription options to suit businesses of different sizes and needs. Plans vary by billing frequency, flexibility, and pricing. Below is a breakdown of each subscription type, along with a quick comparison table and additional details on bundles and add-on features.

## Monthly subscription

Payment and term: Billed monthly with no long-term commitment.

Flexibility: Licenses can be added or removed each month as needed.

Pricing: Highest per-license cost compared to annual options.

Ideal for: Businesses that need maximum adaptability or short-term flexibility.

## Annual subscription with monthly billing

Payment and term: Annual commitment with invoices issued monthly.

Flexibility: A minimum number of contracted licenses must remain active for the year. Additional users or numbers can be added or removed monthly.

Pricing: Lower per-license cost than the monthly subscription, but higher than the annual upfront option.

Ideal for: Businesses with a small core team and seasonal needs or high staff turnover.

## Annual upfront subscription

Payment and term: One-time payment for a 12-month commitment.

Pricing: Up to 25% discount compared to monthly billing.

Flexibility:

* Licenses are locked for the year and cannot be reduced mid-term.
* Licenses can be reassigned at no cost by deleting an unused user before adding a new one. See: Adding Individual Users and Deleting Individual Users
* Simplified budgeting with a single upfront invoice.

Monthly usage invoices:

* Consumption: Charges for international calls, SMS/MMS, AI Voice Assist, and WhatsApp are billed in arrears for the previous month.
* Additional units and subscription add-ons: The next monthly invoice includes a pro-rated charge from the date the unit was added until the end of the annual cycle.

Ideal for: Stable teams looking for the best year-long value.

## Annual upfront with monthly additional units

Structure:

* Commit to a base number of licenses annually (paid upfront).
* Add additional licenses during the year, billed monthly.

Flexibility:

* Base annual licenses are locked in.
* Additional licenses can be removed at any time without waiting for renewal.

Pricing:

* Base licenses benefit from the annual discount.
* Monthly add-ons cost more per license than the annual base rate.

Ideal for: Teams who want the savings of annual billing with the option to scale up temporarily.

## Quick comparison table

| Feature | Monthly plan | Annual (monthly billing) | Annual upfront | Annual upfront + monthly add-ons |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Commitment duration | 1 month | 12 months (annual commitment) | 12 months (paid upfront) | 12-month base (paid upfront) + monthly scalability |
| Pricing per license | Highest | Lower than monthly; higher than annual upfront | Lowest (best value) | Base = lowest; add-ons = monthly rate (higher than base) |
| Billing frequency | Monthly | Monthly | One-time (annual) | Annual for base; monthly for add-ons |
| Remove additional licenses mid-term | Yes\* | Base: No (min contracted users); Additional: Yes (monthly) | No (until renewal) | Base: No; Add-ons: Yes (any month) |
| Add licenses mid-term | Yes | Yes (monthly, scalable) | Yes (pro-rated upfront) | Yes (monthly, scalable; first bill may include pro-rata) |

> Note: This applies to units added beyond your contracted minimum. If you're on a month-to-month plan and want to reduce your core license count instead, use Manage on the Plan page's Users & Teams tile. If you remove an additional (non-contracted) user mid-billing cycle, it will not appear on your next invoice. Since Aircall bills monthly in advance, we do not issue pro-rated refunds or credits for mid-cycle deletions. The user license remains available for reassignment until the end of the current cycle.

## Benefits at a glance

* Monthly plan: Maximum flexibility to adjust licenses as your team changes.
* Annual upfront: Best value with locked-in savings and simplified annual billing.
* Annual upfront + monthly add-ons: Combines discounted annual rates with scalable monthly growth.

## Extended bundles

In addition to domestic call bundles included in your plan, you can upgrade your destinations with extended bundles tailored to your business. For details, see All Aircall bundles.

## Additional features & add-ons

You can enhance your plan with the following add-ons:

| Feature | Description | Related article |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI Assist | Call summaries, topic recognition, sentiment analysis, and CRM logging  It's included in the Professional Plan with no additional cost. | AI Assist |
| AI Assist Pro | Real-time AI coaching and playbooks | AI Assist Pro |
| AI Voice Agent | Automates customer interactions with voice AI.  Every plan gets 50 free AI Voice Agent minutes per month. | Voice AI Agent |
| Analytics+ Add-on | Advanced dashboards and data insights | Analytics |
| WhatsApp Messaging in Aircall | Global messaging through a unified inbox | WhatsApp in Aircall |
| Aircall for Salesforce Service Cloud Voice | Native integration with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice | Service Cloud Voice |

## Additional notes:

* Plan tiers: Essentials, Professional, and Custom each include different features such as AI transcripts, integrations, IVR, and advanced analytics. All tiers follow the monthly vs. annual subscription model.
* Discounts: Annual plans provide up to 25% savings compared to monthly pricing.
* Minimum licenses: Most plans require a minimum of 3 licenses. Custom plans require at least 25. The Starter AI Plan has no minimum, it includes 1 user.
* Add-on services: Features such as AI Assist, AI Voice Agent, Analytics+, WhatsApp, and Salesforce Service Cloud Voice are billed separately, either per license or per minute, depending on the feature.

fetched.title: How to publish apps at Aircall
fetched.text:
Before you start building a public app, you need to be approved as an Aircall Technology Partner. This ensures every app in our marketplace meets the quality and reliability standards our customers expect.

Here is an overview of the process and main milestones:

## Why build on Aircall

Publishing your integration on the Aircall App Marketplace gives your product direct exposure to thousands of Aircall customers actively looking to connect their tools.

* Discoverability — your app is listed in the Aircall marketplace and surfaced to customers during their setup flow
* Credibility — signals to customers that your integration is reviewed, maintained, and reliable
* Growth — partners consistently report growth driven directly through the Aircall App Marketplace and the Technology Partner
* Program Support — access to Aircall's partner team for co-marketing, technical guidance, and early access to new API features

You can learn more about the full program on the Technology Partner Program page.

## Requirements

To be eligible for the Technology Partner program, your product must meet the following criteria

* Finished product — you must have a live, established product with a company website we can visit
* Existing customers — you must have an active customer base using your product

> ☝️
>
> Meeting these requirements doesn't guarantee approval. We aim to keep an open and diverse ecosystem but reserve the right to decline applications at our discretion. Submit an application for full confirmation.

## How to apply

If you meet the requirements above, fill in the partner application form. We'll review your application and get back to you within 5 business days. If you are approved, you'll receive instructions to move on to the Build & Launch phase, where we'll set up your developer account, OAuth credentials, and everything else you need to start building.

Meanwhile, we recommend starting to Plan your integration (See next steps below) while your application is under review — that way you're ready to move fast once approved.

fetched.title: Webhooks Overview
fetched.text:
# Overview

## Getting Started

Your connected systems shouldn't have to ask Aircall what happened — they should already know. Webhooks let you listen to Aircall events in real time, so your systems can react the moment something changes: a call ends, a message arrives, an agent misses a call, a user uninstalls your app.

Instead of polling the API, Aircall pushes a POST request to your desired endpoint for each event as it happens. You decide which events to listen to, and what to do with them.

## Creating webhooks

There are two ways to create webhooks on an Aircall account.

Any admin can set up a webhook manually from the Aircall Dashboard. This is useful for quick testing, one-off setups or with connector tools such as Zapier or Make. See the Help Center article for step-by-step instructions.

Register a webhook programmatically on a user's account without any manual steps — the recommended approach for technology partners building integrations. See Build event-driven integrations with webhooks or the API Reference for details.

## Commonly used call events

For the full list of webhook events, see the API resources.

### Call events

| Event | When it fires |
| --- | --- |
| ``` call.created ``` | A user or system starts a new inbound or outbound call. |
| ``` call.answered ``` | An agent answers an inbound call, or a recipient answers an outbound call. |
| ``` call.hungup ``` | Fires immediately when a call ends. Use this event for real-time dashboards and live agent status. |
| ``` call.ended ``` | Fires about 30 seconds after a call ends, once Aircall has finalized the call data (duration, recording, and more). Use this event to sync call records. |
| ``` call.comm_assets_generated ``` | Fires when recording or voicemail links are ready. Use this event if those assets are not yet available in  ``` call.ended ```  . |
| ``` call.transferred ``` | An agent transfers a call to another agent or number. |
| ``` call.tagged ``` | A user or integration adds a tag to a call. |

### Conversation intelligence events

> Some of these events may require the AI Assist add-on. See the Conversation Intelligence API reference for details.

| Event | When it fires |
| --- | --- |
| ``` transcription.created ``` | A call transcription is available |
| ``` summary.created ``` | A call summary is available |
| ``` topics.created ``` | Key topics are available for a call |
| ``` action_item.created ``` | AI adds an action item based on ongoing conversation. |

Updated 3 months ago
